H1908I.name: Hadad
H1908I.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H1908I.brief: An Edomite prince who opposed Solomon.
H1908I.short: Hadad, an Edomite prince, fled to Egypt and later became an adversary to King Solomon.

forms.meaning: “I shall move softly: I shall love”

H1908G.name: Hadad
H1908G.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1908G.short: Hadad, son of Bedad, became king of Edom after Husham's death.

H1908H.name: Hadad
H1908H.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1908H.brief: The last king of Edom before Israelite rule.
H1908H.short: Hadad, also known as Hadar, was the last king of Edom before the Israelites established their monarchy.

H1909.name: Hadadezer
H1909.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H1909.brief: King of Zobah, defeated by David.
H1909.short: Hadadezer, king of Zobah, was defeated by King David in battle, and his allies, the Arameans, became subject to Israel.

H1913A.name: Hadoram
H1913A.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1913A.brief: Son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem.
H1913A.short: Hadoram was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H1904.name: Hagar
H1904.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1904.brief: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.
H1904.short: Hagar, Sarah's Egyptian maidservant, bore Abraham a son named Ishmael and is also mentioned in Paul's allegory in Galatians.

H1905.name: Hagri
H1905.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1905.brief: A Gadite, father of Mibhar, one of David's mighty men.
H1905.short: Hagri was the father of Mibhar, one of David's mighty men from the tribe of Gad.

H1950.name: Hemam
H1950.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1950.brief: A descendant of Seir the Horite.
H1950.short: Hemam was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau.

H1968H.name: Heman
H1968H.short: Heman was a grandson of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H1968I.name: Heman
H1968I.desc: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
H1968I.brief: A Levite and chief musician in David's time.
H1968I.short: Heman, a Levite, was a chief musician appointed by David to lead worship in the tabernacle.

H1968G.name: Heman
H1968G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1968G.brief: A wise man during Solomon's time.
H1968G.short: Heman was known for his wisdom, though not as wise as Solomon.

H1914.name: Hiddai
H1914.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H1914.brief: One of David's mighty men from Gaash.
H1914.short: Hiddai (also called Hurai) from the brooks of Gaash was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor and military prowess.

H1985.name: Hillel
H1985.short: Hillel the Pirathonite, a father of judge Abdon of Israel, led the nation for ten years.

H1936.name: Hod
H1936.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1936.short: Hod was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H1938G.name: Hodaviah
H1938G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1938G.brief: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.
H1938G.short: Hodaviah (also known as Hodaiah) was one of the descendants of King David through the line of Jeconiah.

H1938H.name: Hodaviah
H1938H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1938H.brief: A leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
H1938H.short: Hodaviah was one of the leaders of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the time of King David.

H1938I.name: Hodaviah
H1938I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1938I.brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
H1938I.short: Hodaviah was a descendant of Benjamin who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H1938J.name: Hodaviah
H1938J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1938J.brief: A Levite who returned from exile.
H1938J.short: Hodaviah (also known as Hodevah or Judah) was a Levite who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity and assisted in rebuilding the temple.

H1940G.name: Hodiah
H1940G.desc: Woman (?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1940G.brief: Wife of a Judahite named Ishbar.
H1940G.short: Hodiah was the wife of Ishbar, a descendant of Judah, and the mother two clans.

H1941H.name: Hodiah
H1941H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1941H.brief: A leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
H1941H.short: Hodiah was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

H1941I.name: Hodiah
H1941I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1941I.brief: A priest who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
H1941I.short: Hodiah was one of the priests who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

H1941G.name: Hodiah
H1941G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1941G.brief: A Levite involved in teaching and worship.
H1941G.short: Hodiah (also known as Judah) was a Levite who assisted in teaching the Law and leading worship during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

H1944.name: Hoham
H1944.brief: King of Hebron, defeated by Joshua.
H1944.short: Hoham, the Amorite king of Hebron, was one of the five kings who formed an alliance against Joshua and the Israelites, but was ultimately defeated.

H1954J.name: Hosea
H1954J.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1954J.brief: A prophet to the northern kingdom of Israel.
H1954J.short: Hosea was a prophet who ministered to the northern kingdom of Israel during the reigns of several kings, calling the people to repent and return to God.

H1955H.name: Hoshaiah
H1955H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1955H.brief: A military leader during Jeremiah's time.
H1955H.short: Hoshaiah, the son of Maaseiah, was one of the military leaders who sought Jeremiah's counsel after the fall of Jerusalem but later disobeyed his prophetic warning.

H1955G.name: Hoshaiah
H1955G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1955G.brief: A leader during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H1955G.short: Hoshaiah was one of the leaders who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H1953.name: Hoshama
H1953.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1953.brief: A descendant of King Jeconiah of Judah.
H1953.short: Hoshama was a descendant of Jeconiah, the exiled king of Judah, according to the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H1954H.name: Hoshea
H1954H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1954H.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Ephraim.
H1954H.short: Hoshea, the son of Azaziah, was the leader of the half-tribe of Ephraim during King David's reign.

H1954G.name: Hoshea
H1954G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1954G.brief: The last king of Israel (northern kingdom).
H1954G.short: Hoshea was the last king of Israel, reigning from around 732 to 722 BC, until the Assyrian conquest of Samaria.

H1954I.name: Hoshea
H1954I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1954I.brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
H1954I.short: Hoshea was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

H1956.name: Hothir
H1956.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1956.brief: A son of Heman, a musician in David's court.
H1956.short: Hothir was one of the fourteen sons of Heman, appointed by King David to lead worship in the temple.

H1910.name: Hadad-rimmon
H1910.brief: A place near Megiddo associated with mourning for Josiah.
H1910.short: Hadad-rimmon was a place near Megiddo where a great lamentation was held for King Josiah, who was mortally wounded there.

H1990.name: Ham
H1990.brief: A place where Chedorlaomer defeated the Zuzim in battle.
H1990.short: Ham was a place where Chedorlaomer and his allies defeated the Zuzim in battle during the war of the kings (<ref="Genesis 14:5">Genesis 14:5</ref>).

H1997.name: Hamonah
H1997.brief: A city in Ezekiel's vision, meaning "multitude" or "horde."
H1997.short: Hamonah is a city mentioned in Ezekiel's vision (<ref="Ezk.39.16">Ezk.39.16</ref>), its name meaning "multitude" or "horde," likely referring to the burial place of Gog's army.

H1996.name: Hamon-gog Valley
H1996.brief: A valley where Gog and his army will be buried.
H1996.short: The Valley of Hamon-gog is the place where Gog and his army will be buried after their defeat, as prophesied by Ezekiel (<ref="Ezk.39.11, 15">Ezk.39.11, 15</ref>).

H1912.name: India
H1912.brief: The eastern extent of Ahasuerus' Persian Empire
H1912.short: India, the eastern extent of Ahasuerus' Persian Empire (<ref="Esther 1:1; 8:9">Esther 1:1; 8:9</ref>).

H1902G.name: Higgaion
H1902G.brief: A musical or literary term in the Psalms
H1902G.short: Higgaion, mentioned in <ref="Psalm 9:16">Psalm 9:16</ref>, is a musical or literary term of uncertain meaning, possibly indicating a pause for meditation or reflection.

H1966.name: Lucifer
H1966.brief: Symbolic name referring to the king of Babylon's fall
H1966.short: Isaiah poetically describes the king of Babylon as Lucifer, portraying his fall from power.
